messages:
harper: Quick ping on postmortem Action Item #21 (SLA alert tuning for Dedicated fallbacks)  overdue and owner is @lee. Any short status + ETA? :wave:

lee: Sorry  been triaging a customer incident. Blocker was missing test coverage for the routing policy change. I have a branch and tests WIP: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/5233. ETA for tests + review: tomorrow morning.

jodi: We have a sales review on Friday; need this in by EOD Thursday if possible. If tests are the blocker, can you push a test-only PR to unblock reviewers?

lee: I can split test-first. Opening a small PR for the alert rule smoke now.

ops-bot: Reminder: Action Item #21 assigned to lee is overdue (due 1823360389). Please update the tracker: https://tracker.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-520/actions.

sam: If it slips, we should consider enabling the temporary fallback policy for affected clusters. That reduces SLA risk while tests land. I can coordinate the config flip.

lee: Test-only PR opened and CI passing: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/5234. Adding integration tests to main PR now. New ETA: tomorrow 11am PT.

jodi: Thanks  I'm scheduling a short sync with SRE tomorrow 11:30 to validate alert thresholds post-merge.

[next day]

ops-bot: CI passed for PR 5233, canary in dedicated-eu went green at 1823459989.

lee: Merged both PRs and updated tracker. Added a short recurrence note in the postmortem about "routing-policy alerting gaps".

sam: Confirmed we didn't need the temporary fallback. Will monitor the SLA dashboard for 24h.

harper: Verified tracker and postmortem. Closing Action Item #21. :white_check_mark:

lee: I'll follow up with a small retrospective ticket to document lessons and owners for alert ownership rotations. Closing thread. :v:
